claims.claim: The Company describes itself as a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment worldwide.
claims.quote: We are a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe.

claims.claim: Management states that its strategy focuses on hit experiences delivered across all relevant platforms using multiple business models.
claims.quote: Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models.

claims.claim: The firm acknowledges competition from a broad spectrum of interactive‑entertainment firms, from tiny studios to large, well‑funded rivals.
claims.quote: •Other interactive entertainment companies that range in size and cost structure from very small with limited resources to very large with greater financial, marketing, technical, and other resources than ours.

claims.claim: Take‑Two notes that overseas sales constitute a material portion of total revenue.
claims.quote: International sales are a significant part of our business.

claims.claim: Management lists economic stability, timely title releases, console‑generation growth, mobile performance, live‑service focus and FX stability as the primary drivers of its outlook.
claims.quote: Key assumptions and dependencies underlying the Company’s outlook include: a continuation of the current economic backdrop; the timely delivery of the titles included in this financial outlook; continued growth in the installed base of PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S; the ability to develop and publish products that capture market share for these current generation systems while also leveraging opportunities on PC, mobile and other platforms; factors affecting our performance on mobile, such as player acquisition costs; our ongoing focus on our live services portfolio and new game pipeline; and stable foreign exchange rates.

claims.claim: The company has disclosed a scheduled launch date for the next Grand Theft Auto title.
claims.quote: Grand Theft Auto VI is planned for release on November 19, 2026.

claims.claim: Management highlights the expanding role of mobile gaming and predicts continued growth in mobile device usage.
claims.quote: An increased percentage of our operations consists of mobile gaming. The number of people using mobile Internet-enabled devices has increased dramatically over time, and we expect that this trend will continue.

claims.claim: No specific quantitative forecast for post‑launch revenue of Grand Theft Auto VI is provided in the filing; any projection would be speculative.

gaps: The filing does not contain a forward‑looking revenue or earnings estimate for the Grand Theft Auto VI launch beyond the qualitative statement about timing.
There is no disclosed plan for new geographic expansion beyond the general statement in line 120; details of target markets are absent.
